decisions.rationale: One performance case, one subject, one governing work context; separate organization, person, employment, membership, assignment and source evidence masters.
Employee, contractor and founder examples; narrative-only and zero-assessment drafts allowed; no invented employment or score.
Unknown and disputed contribution remain claims; activity counts cannot alone issue an assessment; human accountability remains explicit.
Repeated case-local records with explicit supersession, temporal provenance and dispute qualification. Cross-case sessions remain peers.
Acknowledgement and recommendation cannot execute pay or mutate grade. Shared instruments and awards require later peer-model disposition.
Seven external primary precedents plus one Vercy internal profile, verified by Codex to ledger scope; no licensed-schema or legal compliance claim.
Actual browser memos from Claude and Grok are retained verbatim. Neither emitted the structured synthesis. The failed Claude CLI attempt is not relabeled successful.
Claude returned PASS_WITH_REQUIRED_DRAFT_FIXES and no critical conflicts. R1-R4 were addressed by Codex; audit scope and unreviewed final-file gap remain visible.
This reference profile rejects omission of applicable dispute context. No implemented exceptional-disclosure bypass.
This first model does not finish EM-PEO-06. Shared scale, calibration session, recognition peers, full profiles and native data binding remain explicit follow-up scope.
